about: What an endpoint does with a cast before anything plays. It needs ui/screencast in the grant and the offer, a frame rate of 1 to 240, a clock the offer lists (the best, stepped then streamed, when none is named; never sampled), a longest time and frame count within the offer's, steps in time order within the longest time, and each step's interface in the grant: invoke needs ui/act covering the action's class, perform ui/input, present and release ui/history. A present asking mark: false is refused as mark_required outside a dev instance. An offer without ui/screencast is no_screencast_interface, and a clock the offer does not list, or sampled, is unoffered_clock naming the clock. A step's own refusal is its operation's word; a frame rate, a bound or the order is misfit_arguments naming the field. The input is the offer, the interfaces the grant holds, ui/act's classes and the cast, whose date changes nothing here; the answer is {admitted: {clock, class, last_frame, step_frames}} or {refused}. A step at t ms first shows in frame ceil(t × fps / 1000).

vectors.name: a fixture sequence at 60 fps is admitted, its second present first shown in frame 6 (100 ms)
the same sequence at 120 fps first shows its second present in frame 12
a cast naming its start's date is admitted as the same cast without one
a run with a perform step is refused under a grant that does not hold ui/input
a run with a perform step is admitted under a grant that holds ui/input, at the class of input
a present step asking mark: false is refused as mark_required outside a dev instance
a present step asking mark: false is admitted in a dev instance
a cast without ui/screencast in the grant is refused
a cast to an offer that does not name ui/screencast is refused, naming it
a cast naming a clock the offer does not list is refused, naming the clock
a cast naming sampled is refused, since no app offers it
a cast asking for the best clock gets stepped where the offer lists it
a cast asking for the best clock gets streamed where the offer lists only streamed, and an empty run there reads only
a frame rate of 241 is refused
a frame rate of 0 is refused
a frame rate of 240 is admitted
steps out of time order are refused, naming the later step
a step past the longest time is refused, naming it
a cast past the offer's longest time is refused
a cast past the offer's longest screencast in frames is refused
an invoke step whose class the grant does not cover is refused as ui/act refuses it
an invoke step takes its action's class
an invoke step of an action the offer does not list is refused
a release step with no present before it is refused
a present then a release is admitted
a present step to an app that takes no fixtures is refused as present is
